_comment: Design lock repeated in every image prompt for this character. Prompts describe only what is visible: image models act on every noun they read, so negative phrasing ("no X") draws X. npm run art-requests rejects negative words.
name: Rook
lock: Same character as the attached reference image: Rook, a tall, lean, one-armed woman in her mid-twenties with sharp features and a pale scar along her jaw. She fights southpaw, left-handed: her single arm is her left arm, on the far side of her body, wrapped in cloth from the knuckles to the elbow. Her near shoulder, the one facing the viewer, ends in a short coat sleeve folded flat and fastened to the shoulder with a round gold pin; below that pin the coat hangs smooth and straight down her near side. Same long dark hair in a braid with a silver band, hanging behind her head. Same knee-length oxblood fighting coat with embroidery at the collar, cuffs and hem, torn and patched, the coat tails split at the back. Same brown leather belt with a gold buckle, warm brown-black trousers and boots, and cloth wraps on her shins. Same colours as the reference, exactly: the coat is a deep muted oxblood red-brown; the embroidery and trim are a dark tarnished bronze-gold, clearly darker and more orange than her skin; her skin is a warm tan; her trousers and boots are a warm brown-black; the wraps are a dull warm grey-beige.

arm_words.left_arm: her left arm (her single arm, on the far side of her body, the arm raised in the guard in the reference)

near_side_rule: In every pose: one arm, her left, on the far side of her body, and one fist. Her near shoulder shows the flat folded sleeve with the round gold pin, and the coat hangs smooth down her near side.
guard: southpaw side-on fighting stance, weight on the back foot, her left fist raised in front of her chin, chin down
